title: Lane Ownership Is For Speed, Not Territory — Do, Record, Hand Off

source.source_reference: Shawn directive via Naya5 master directive + Naya4 proposal, #1354, 2026-10-08

human_note.subject: Don't wait — do, record, hand off
human_note.text: Assign lane work to parallelize, never to create fiefdoms. If a lane is active and parallel, stay in your lane. If someone is stalled and blocking — for any reason — do the thing yourself: same quality bar, record that you did it, notify the owner, hand them their next task. Waiting because "it's their job" is the bottleneck.

naya_note.text: Operating rule for all seats: active+parallel -> stay in lane; stalled+blocking -> take and go. Always leave a receipt: what done, where recorded, next owner.

learning_lesson.text: Authority-by-seat must not become permission-to-stall. Escalate past bottlenecks by executing, not waiting.
